shots.line: Okay, y'all keep asking what the back of these looks like.
shots.still: SHOT: SCENE: mirror-style photo from behind and a little to her right, chest to floor: she stands with her back three-quarters to the camera next to the island, weight on her left leg; her right hand rests flat on the back of her right hip, fingers together, whole wrist visible. The white circle mark shows at the centre back under the waistband. FEET: She faces away from the camera toward the island: both toes point AWAY from the camera, the backs of both heels face the camera. Image 1 = the real pants from every side (listing photos, black and dark brown). Image 2 = the real side pocket: a flat rectangular patch pocket on the outer hip, straight top edge under the waistband, phone top showing. Image 3 = the real centre-back OQQ circle mark. Image 4 = the real shoe from every side. Image 5 = the real woven VANS side tab (small black tab, white VANS letters). Image 6 = her real body and skin tone (ignore its clothes and room). Image 7 = the real room. HER: Grace, exactly the body in image 6: slim build, medium-deep brown skin exactly like image 6 on every bit of skin, long almond nails with white nude polish. Her face is NEVER in frame: the top edge of the frame cuts at her chest. A white ribbed cropped square-neck tank that ends at the top of the waistband, a strip of bare waist showing between them. THE PANTS must match image 1 and image 2 exactly, colour for colour: the real OQQ high-waisted wide-leg pants in TRUE BLACK. Smooth matte stretch jersey, solid and opaque (never sheer, nothing shows through), no shine. A wide plain high waistband about a hand wide sitting at her natural waist, no drawstring, no buttons, no belt loops, no fly. One thin stitched seam line runs down the front of each leg from the waistband to the hem. Fitted over the hip and thigh, then wide and straight from the knee down to a full-length hem that covers the top of the shoe and brushes the floor. THE POCKET (image 2): ONE flat tonal patch pocket sewn onto the OUTER SIDE of the hip, a tall rectangle about the size of a phone, outlined by a thin stitched seam, its straight top edge running level just under the waistband; it opens ONLY along that top edge, and a phone sits upright inside with only its top showing above the edge. There is NO slanted, curved or slash pocket opening anywhere and no front trouser pockets. Only the small white round OQQ circle mark at the centre back under the waistband (image 3); no other logos, no ® or ™, no text. ON HER FEET, both feet: the real Vans Premium Authentic low-top in sequin checkerboard (image 4): large black squares covered in black sequins, large off-white squares plain canvas (black and OFF-WHITE only, never brown, tan or beige checks), black laces through black eyelets (no gold or metal eyelets), the same checkerboard all the way round the heel (no solid black heel panel), a small BLACK woven side tab with white VANS letters (image 5), off-white rubber sidewall, gum sole. The hem covers most of each shoe so only the front half and toe cap show. Exactly two shoes, one on each foot, worn the right way round: the toe of each shoe points where her knees and the front of her body point, the heel at the back under the hem. The sequins look like real sequins in daylight: no added sparkles, glints, stars or light effects. PLACE: the real kitchen in image 7: sage-green kitchen island with a white marble top, black round bar stools, warm oak floor. LIGHT: bright daylight, soft and even, neutral white balance: true black stays black, the brown stays chocolate, no yellow, orange or golden cast, no dark or moody grade. A real phone photo, casual and realistic, vertical 9:16. No text, no captions, no watermark anywhere.
